prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an EIGHT-ICON game item illustration atlas matching ONLY the hand-drawn art style, thin gray-brown outlines, muted pale ochre, gray-olive, taupe-brown palette, pigment shading and restrained texture of the provided 08 character reference. Do NOT include any characters, people, faces, character body silhouettes or the reference board's composition. This is for a coherent wasteland card component. EXACT grid FOUR COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, canvas1536x1024, each cell384x512. Center each individual icon at its cell center, max240x260 pixels, with generous empty padding; all 8 icons separate, no overlaps. Reading order left-to-right, top-to-bottom: 1 a wrapped clenched fist (basic attack); 2 a single worn hiking boot with one small side-step gesture line (basic dodge); 3 a chipped short kitchen cleaver with a brown handle (knife equipment); 4 a rolled gray-olive scarf/hood fabric with two tiny evasion motion marks (strong dodge); 5 a simple repair kit of a bandage roll, needle and small spool (repair); 6 a rough dented iron pipe with one small impact mark (heavy hit); 7 a slender cleaver slash arc with a single tan brush swoosh (temporary slash); 8 a torn faded brown old-world banknote (cash relic). Simple strong silhouettes, clear edges, small hand-drawn details, two or three broad tones per object. Dark lines should be thin and crisp, never chunky black contours. No gradients or fog. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA-ZERO background around all icons, opaque object interiors. No paper rectangle, no checkerboard, no floor or cast shadows, no labels, no text, no numbers, no grid lines. Maintain a common scale, line quality and palette across the entire set. The reference is style and palette only; draw the requested objects.
